title: Monitor Output
description: JSON produced by agent-meta-monitor.py with operational health metrics.

json_validation_failures.description: Number of JSON validation failures found in reconcile logs.

mcp_rejection_count.description: Number of MCP write rejections found in update logs.

total_execution_time_seconds.description: Elapsed time between first and last log timestamp, or null.

health_status.description: Overall health: healthy if no failures/rejections, warning otherwise.
